notes: The W4 refit (owner 2026-10-11: a simple profitability test of the frozen predictor on W4; the plan's W3 refit). A FLAT overlay for configs/workflow-production.json, layered BEFORE a machine-local file that supplies `pick`, `frozen` and `recipe` (the paths the earlier production run used; see docs/plans/2026-10-06-wsl-data-pull-runbook.md, B8): python -m dskit.pipeline workflow configs/workflow-production.json --args configs/production-args-w4.json --args <local>.json. One block: forward_start is W4's first day and evaluate_through is W5's start (exclusive), so the model trains on every minute before 2026-07-31 (the embargo day is dropped, as for W2) and is scored on the 45 days of W4; retrain_days is the recipe's 60, which clips to that one block. allow_past_w2 opens W4 only: an evaluate_through past W5's start is refused whatever this says, and the dates are pinned to the cuts that own them by tests/test_zoo_production.py. panel_source/panel_relpath point every lane at the extended panel (configs/run-panel-build-w4.json, registered by configs/source-panel-minute-w4.json), because the zoo's panel stops at W2's end; the training rows are the same rows (checked in runbook B8). work_dir is relative to the child root and git-ignored; configs/run-w4-take.json reads the saved model from it.
